summary: A level 5 Slayer beginner task from Turael, Spria, Mazchna and Mortimer. Crawling hands are tiny undead with a max hit of 1-2, so any combat style with no prayer kills them; they are not aggressive and drop bones plus cheap gloves and rings. The usual place is the ground floor of the Slayer Tower north-west of Canifis, which holds 24 spawns, though the Meiyerditch Laboratories also have them. Because they are undead, Crumble Undead and the salve amulet work on them.
styleNotes: Undead, so the salve amulet and Crumble Undead work on them; not aggressive, max hit 1-2, no poison or venom immunity noted.

summary: A Vannaka-only task at 50 combat. styleNotes: Lack defence in all three melee styles so any melee weapon works; weak to Earth spells (40%); ranged works from across the river; not immune to cannon or thralls.

summary: Custodian stalkers are found only in the Stalker Den beneath the Custodia Pass after Shadows of Custodia; juveniles need 54 Slayer, matures 67 and elders 76. They hit with melee blocked by Protect from Melee, but at low health they use a bleed special that is blocked by Protect from Magic instead, so bring healing when fighting several at once. The south-western caves are multicombat and cannonable, which makes chinchompas, burst spells or a cannon the fast option; single-way caves in the south-east and north suit melee with safespots. Players are encouraged to reach 76 Slayer for elders, which have the best drops and are the only ones that can spawn the Ancient Custodian.
styleNotes: Multicombat area favours chinchompas, venator bow or barrage spells; melee works in the single-way caves; high magic defence gear such as dragonhide reduces the bleed special.
usefulItems: High Level Alchemy runes (juveniles drop adamant scimitars)

summary: Dagannoth are a fast, easy task once Horror from the Deep is done; they are much weaker than their combat level suggests. The Lighthouse basement and Jormungand's Prison are multicombat and are the standard cannon spots, with the Lighthouse offering some of the fastest Slayer XP in the game and the prison housing 62 melee-only dagannoth so Protect from Melee covers everything. The Catacombs of Kourend are multicombat but not cannonable and suit AFK melee with prayer. Waterbirth Island dagannoth are far stronger, and the Dagannoth Kings can be killed on the task.
styleNotes: Weak to Earth spells (35%); level 74 Lighthouse dagannoth use Ranged while others use stab melee; not immune to cannon or thralls.

summary: Dark beasts need 90 Slayer and 90 combat and are permanently aggressive, never becoming tolerant. Melee with Protect from Melee and high prayer-bonus armour such as Proselyte is the standard method; they only open with Magic if you attack first or they cannot reach you, so a cannon is legal but not recommended. Both spots are single-way; the Mourner Tunnels hold 19 beasts and are reached instantly by Slayer ring after Mourning's End Part II, while the Iorwerth Dungeon has 10 and needs Song of the Elves but can drop crystal shards. Bring a herb sack and gem bag for the loot.
styleNotes: Melee is most effective; weak to Earth spells (60%); highly accurate melee so Protect from Melee is recommended; not immune to cannon or thralls.

summary: Drakes are level 84 Slayer wingless dragons on the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, with a separate task-only room that the wiki recommends because it is smaller for a cannon. They use Ranged and ranged-melee attacks blocked by Protect from Missiles, plus a volcanic breath every seven attacks that dragonfire protection reduces or a one-tile sidestep avoids. Boots of stone, brimstone or granite boots are required in the dungeon unless the elite Kourend and Kebos diary is done. Melee with a dragon hunter lance is typical; many players block the task because of its high weight, lacklustre drops and the drakes' flat armour.
styleNotes: Draconic, so dragonbane weapons (dragon hunter lance, crossbow, wand) are very effective; take 50% more damage from water spells; immune to poison and venom; have 2 flat armour; not immune to cannon or thralls.
requiredItems: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots (not needed after the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary)
usefulItems: Anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield with antifire, or super antifire
